crossRefs.note: Your gates also shall be open continually; they shall not be shut day nor night, that men may bring to you the wealth…
There will be no night, and they need no lamp light or sun light; for the Lord God will illuminate them. They will…
Your sun will not go down any more, nor will your moon withdraw itself; for Yahweh will be your everlasting light, and…
It will be a unique day which is known to Yahweh; not day, and not night; but it will come to pass, that at evening…

translations.web: Its gates will in no way be shut by day (for there will be no night there),
translations.bsb: Its gates will never be shut at the end of the day, because there will be no night there.
translations.kjv: And the gates of it shall not be shut at all by day: for there shall be no night there.
translations.asv: And the gates thereof shall in no wise be shut by day (for there shall be no night there):
